topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct with annual acknowledgment; POL-05 acceptable use acknowledgment; disciplinary process (POL-01 4.13); nuclear safety culture and employee concerns program
evidence: Code of conduct acknowledgment report (98%); POL-05 acknowledgments; disciplinary log sample

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk and POA&M reports, including GDSR readiness
GDSR system owner (Energy Marketing and Settlements Manager), technical owner (IT Director), and ISSO (IT Security Manager) designated; reporting lines in POL-01
Background checks at hire; annual security awareness training; role-based training for IT staff
evidence: Training completion report (97%); HR checklist sample
gap: No role-based training for settlements analysts and developers on data integrity and change control for GDSR
remediation: Role-based module for the 3 settlements analysts and 2 developers before the observation period

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP and the policy set; POA&M items have owners and dates; performance goals for the system owner include GDSR readiness
Asset inventory (CM-8) and SSP data flows for the business network and cloud
evidence: Asset inventory export; P02 and P04 data flow diagrams
gap: GDSR data flow (meter data portal download, historian replica feed, adjustments, buyer delivery) is not documented end to end; 7 devices missing from the inventory (POAM-009)
remediation: GDSR data flow diagram and data dictionary; inventory reconciliation

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-17 and effective 2026-10-01; intranet publication; awareness training
evidence: Policy approval record; intranet page; training content
gap: No written GDSR operating procedures (daily delivery, adjustments, exception handling); staff rely on the knowledge of 3 analysts
remediation: Write and train on GDSR operating procedures

control_description: PPA-2 data exhibit sets delivery times, data definitions, and a 48-hour incident notice; buyer security contact on file
gap: No system description or statement of service commitments written for the buyer; incident notice has never been exercised
remediation: Draft the system description and management assertion; exercise the buyer notice in the 2026-11-05 tabletop

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives for the GDSR service (accurate, complete, timely data; confidentiality of buyer data) stated in the P01 risk appetite and the PPA-2 exhibit
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment covering GDSR risks (P01 R-026 to R-028)
Fraud risks considered in P01 (business email compromise R-029)
gap: Manual adjustments to generation and attribute data are not analyzed as a fraud or misstatement risk (an adjustment changes settlement amounts and attribute counts)
remediation: Add an adjustment misstatement scenario to the risk register; require second review of every adjustment (PI1.3)

control_description: IT change advisory board; CSP change screening standard STD-04 in draft
evidence: Change advisory board minutes; STD-04 draft
gap: Changes to GDSR scripts and the analytics feed are not assessed for impact (POAM-007)
remediation: Issue STD-04 (2026-11-30) and route GDSR changes through it

control_description: Annual independent control assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm with Nuclear Oversight (P07); MSSP monthly service reports
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported quarterly to the audit committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 Moderate baseline and mapped to P01 risks (P02)
General IT controls documented in the SSP; configuration standard STD-01 in draft
gap: No configuration baseline for the GDSR virtual machines and database (POAM-008)
remediation: Benchmark-based baselines for the GDSR virtual machines and database; monthly scans against them

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 and the standards index
gap: Standards STD-01, STD-02, STD-03, STD-07 still in draft; GDSR procedures not written (CC2.2)
remediation: Issue the standards on the P06 schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Cloud identity provider SSO with MFA for all users; cloud consoles through the privileged access broker; GDSR database accessible only from the workloads subnet
evidence: Identity provider configuration; broker logs; security group rules
gap: 16 standing domain administrators who can reach the site-to-cloud path (POAM-002); GDSR database uses one shared administrator login
remediation: Named database administrator accounts through the broker; FIDO2 for administrators; remove standing domain administrators

control_description: HR-driven provisioning with manager and system-owner approval; GDSR roles approved by the system owner
Annual access review (last January 2026); termination feed disables accounts
gap: Transfers keep prior roles (POAM-001); GDSR application and database roles have never been reviewed; reviews are annual, not quarterly
remediation: Quarterly GDSR access review signed by the system owner; transfer workflow removes roles

control_description: Site data center and EOF under the Station physical protection program; cloud data centers inherited from the provider (provider SOC 2)
Media sanitized or destroyed with certificates (POL-04 4.7); cloud storage deletion per provider

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: No internet ingress to the workloads account; cloud firewall; mutual TLS to the buyer data portal; site-to-cloud VPN
evidence: Cloud firewall rules; P04 control map
gap: The site-to-cloud VPN terminates on a flat server VLAN that any workstation can reach (POAM-018); shared vendor VPN accounts on the site side (POAM-003)
remediation: Segment the server layer; named vendor accounts

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher for all external transmission; mutual TLS for buyer delivery; IPsec site-to-cloud

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all managed endpoints and servers, including GDSR virtual machines, with 24x7 MSSP monitoring
evidence: EDR coverage report; P07 SI-3 results (Satisfied)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly vulnerability scans of on-premises systems; cloud posture management
gap: Cloud virtual machines, including GDSR, are not in the scan scope; 6 of 40 critical findings were remediated late (POAM-015)
remediation: Add cloud virtual machines to monthly scans; track remediation to the standard timeline

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP 24x7 SIEM monitoring of endpoints, identity, and cloud control-plane logs
gap: GDSR database audit logs and application logs are not sent to the SIEM; no egress volume alerting (POAM-005)
remediation: Onboard GDSR logs; alert on adjustments outside business hours and on bulk exports

control_description: MSSP triage; incident log; notification decision log (POL-03 4.8)
gap: No triage criteria for data integrity events (for example a wrong file sent to the buyer)
remediation: Add GDSR integrity events to the incident criteria and the P08 matrix (PPA-2 notice)

control_description: POL-03 and two P08 runbooks approved 2026-09-17; MSSP and panel forensics; PPA-2 48-hour notice in the notification matrix
gap: Runbooks are new and untested (POAM-012)
remediation: Joint tabletop 2026-11-05 including a GDSR data integrity inject

control_description: Daily backups to the recovery account (35-day write-once retention); spreadsheet fallback with a second reviewer
gap: GDSR has never been restored from backup; restores are tested only for file shares (POAM-010)
remediation: Restore test of the GDSR database and application to the recovery account; record the time against the 24-hour RTO

control_description: IT change advisory board for infrastructure changes
evidence: Change advisory board minutes; GDSR script repository
gap: GDSR meter-data scripts are edited directly in production with no ticket, test, or second reviewer (POAM-007; R-026)
remediation: Version-controlled repository; pull request with second reviewer; test against the prior day; deployment only by the pipeline

control_description: BIA (P05) sets BP-11 RTO 24 hours and MTD 72 hours; spreadsheet fallback; cyber insurance

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor tiers and annual Tier 1 SOC 2 review (STD-03 draft; Part B of this deliverable)
gap: 9 of 24 Tier 1 vendors without current assurance (POAM-016); GDSR subservice organizations not yet listed with complementary controls
remediation: Complete Tier 1 reviews; list subservice organizations and CSOCs in the system description

control_description: Cloud capacity and performance monitoring for the GDSR virtual machines and database; workload is small (one daily file, monthly statements)
Daily backups to the separate recovery account with 35-day write-once retention; provider availability zones; single region accepted (R-027)
Disaster recovery plan covers WMS and CAP/EDMS; GDSR covered by backups only
gap: No recovery test of GDSR; the DR plan does not cover it (POAM-010)
remediation: Add GDSR to the DR plan and test it before the observation period

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Buyer data and settlement data classified Confidential (POL-04 4.1); encrypted at rest and in transit
gap: Sensitivity labels not yet deployed (POAM-020); buyer confidentiality obligations not listed in one place
remediation: Label GDSR exports; register of confidentiality commitments

control_description: Media disposal under POL-04 4.7
gap: No retention and deletion rule for buyer data at the end of the PPA term or for exports on analyst laptops
remediation: Retention schedule entry for GDSR data; quarterly cleanup of local exports

control_description: PPA-2 data exhibit defines hourly net generation and attribute quantities; calculation logic is in the scripts
gap: Processing specifications (data dictionary, calculation rules, estimation rules when meter data is late) are not documented outside the scripts
remediation: Write the GDSR processing specification and have the buyer confirm the definitions

control_description: Daily download of settlement-quality hourly revenue meter data from the transmission owner meter data portal; historian replica data used for validation
gap: Completeness checks (24 hourly values, no gaps, no duplicates) are manual and not recorded
remediation: Automated input completeness and range checks with an exception queue

control_description: Scripts calculate hourly net generation and attribute quantities; analysts make manual adjustments for meter corrections
gap: Manual adjustments are not logged or reviewed; scripts change without control (R-026)
remediation: Adjustment log with reason, preparer, and second reviewer; change control per CC8.1

control_description: Daily file delivered to the buyer portal by 10:00 with delivery receipts; monthly settlement statements reconciled to revenue meters
gap: No review before the daily file is sent; reconciliation is monthly, so an error can reach the buyer for up to 30 days
remediation: Automated pre-delivery check against meter totals; documented daily review

control_description: Inputs and outputs retained in the GDSR database and backed up daily
gap: Adjusted values overwrite originals; no history of what was sent to the buyer each day
remediation: Keep immutable copies of each delivered file and the inputs used
